title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes Hits It Big With Debut Episodes
content: Mordecai, Rigby, Benson, Skips, Muscle Man, and the other park employees for one of Cartoon Network’s biggest franchises are back. Regular Show: The Lost Tapes has debuted on Cartoon Network, acting as something of a prequel and a sequel to the original Regular Show series.
author: ComicBook

title: Victoria of Many Faces Anime's 1st Promo Video Previews Ending Theme Song
content: The staff for the television anime of writer Syuu and illustrator Nanna Fujimi 's Victoria of Many Faces ( Tefuda ga Ōme no Victoria ) light novel series began streaming on Friday the first main promotional video, which previews the ending theme song "En no Tsuki" by three-piece band KI_EN .
author: ANN

title: Berserk Reveals Exciting New Details For Summer Return
content: After nearly a year without a new chapter being released, “strugglers” can expect the Berserk manga to return next month. On June 12th, Young Animal will release the 384th chapter of the dark series, bringing readers back to a dire predicament for Guts and his allies.
author: ComicBook

title: Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love Anime's Teaser Unveils Cast, More Staff, January 2027 Debut
content: Kadokawa debuted a teaser promotional video for the television anime of Ayune Araragi 's Ms. Isshiki Wants to Know About Love ( Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai ) manga on Friday. The teaser announces the main cast, more staff members, and the January 2027 premiere for the anime.
author: ANN

title: Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi Anime Film Streams Teaser Video
content: The staff of Made in Abyss: Mezameru Shinpi ( Made in Abyss : Awakening Mystery), the first film in the new Made in Abyss anime film trilogy , revealed a teaser video for the film on Friday. The film will open on October 23.
author: ANN

title: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even Anime Reveals 3 More Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Metabo Hagure 's A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires ( Buchigire Reijō wa Hōfuku wo Chikaimashita. Madōsho no Chikara de Sokoku wo Tataki Tsubushimasu ) light novel series revealed three more cast members on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You Releases Special Opening and Ending Videos
content: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You released special opening and ending theme song videos on Friday ahead of its early streaming debut on ABEMA on June 3, prior to the anime’s regular broadcast in July 2026. The opening and ending sequences feature entirely different songs and animation.
author: Anime Corner

title: Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Gets Season 2
content: Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World is getting a Season 2 in October 2026. The staff and cast were also revealed along with a new visual. ZERO-G is animating the sequel, replacing Cloud Hearts. Masahiro Takata returns to direct and write the script for the second season.
author: Anime Corner

title: Rich Girl Caretaker TV Anime Reveals July 4 Debut, Promo Video, More Cast
content: The official website for the anime adaptation of author Yusaku Sakaishi and illustrator Sakura Miwabe 's Rich Girl Caretaker ( Saijo no Osewa ) light novel series revealed the first promotional video, July 4 debut, opening theme information, and more cast on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer Featuring Main Cast, January 2027 Release Date
content: The upcoming Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love anime revealed a teaser trailer on Friday, which features the main cast and a January 2027 release date. The main cast includes: • Riko Akechi as Rinna Milford Isshiki • Shuichiro Umeda as Meishi Rokutanda Studio Sakura Create is animating the series with Kazuya Komai…
author: Anime Corner
